era: Late-2019 NPR (the header and player refresh that shipped in autumn 2019 and is on the 2019-11 captures; the grey NEWSCAST / LIVE RADIO / SHOWS player of early 2019 was replaced then): white header with the npr logo, SIGN IN · NPR SHOP · red DONATE, dark grey #4a4a4a nav bar with condensed uppercase NEWS / ARTS & LIFE / MUSIC / SHOWS & PODCASTS / SEARCH, blue player (HOURLY NEWS · LISTEN LIVE · PLAYLIST), white cards with slugs in small uppercase grey and bold titles on a #f9f9f9 page; same design for every visitor.
